import { Tabs, TabItem, Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

The admin panel is a client of a plain JSON API at `/admin/api`. Anything you can do in the panel, you can do from a
script: moderate users, query and delete events, manage media, change settings, toggle plugins.

- Base path: `/admin/api`
- JSON in, JSON out. Errors are `{ "error": "…", "code": "…" }` with a 4xx or 5xx status.
- Lists answer `{ items }`; paginated ones also carry `total`.
- Request bodies are capped at 1 MiB (the event import route streams up to 256 MiB).
- Every response is `Cache-Control: no-store`.

The full contract, with every request and response type, lives in
[`packages/sdk/src/admin-contract.ts`](https://github.com/beamhop/relay/blob/main/packages/sdk/src/admin-contract.ts).

The admin API is on by default (`admin.enabled`). Turning it off also removes the panel and NIP-86.

## Authentication

There are two ways in. Both resolve to an admin with a role; the role decides what you may call.

<Tabs>
<TabItem label="NIP-98 (scripts)">

Sign a kind **27235** event per request and send it base64-encoded:

```
Authorization: Nostr <base64 of the signed event>
```

The event must have:

- a `u` tag with the **absolute URL** of the request, built from the relay's public URL:
  `https://relay.example.com/admin/api/users?status=banned` (query string included);
- a `method` tag matching the HTTP method;
- a `created_at` within 60 seconds of the server's clock.

Optionally add a `payload` tag with the hex SHA-256 of the body; if present, it must match.

Each authorization event is accepted **once**. Sign a fresh one for every request.

NIP-98 requests need nothing else: no cookie, no CSRF header.

</TabItem>
<TabItem label="Cookie session">

Log in once and keep the cookie:

```sh
curl -c cookies.txt -X POST \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: beamhop' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"login":"npub1…","password":"…"}' \
  https://relay.example.com/admin/api/auth/password
```

The server sets `bh_session` (HttpOnly, `SameSite=Strict`, path `/admin`). Sessions last 7 days, renewed while you
use them, up to 30 days in total.

Login routes:

| Route | Body |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /auth/password` | `{ login, password, totp? }` — `login` is an npub, hex pubkey or NIP-05 name |
| `GET /auth/challenge` → `POST /auth/nostr` | `{ event }`: a kind 27235 event with the `u` from the challenge response, `method: POST` and a `challenge` tag |
| `POST /auth/passkey/login/options` → `/verify` | WebAuthn |

Password login has to be enabled per admin first (`beamhop admin password <npub>` or the panel's account page).

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

### The `X-Requested-With: beamhop` rule

Every `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE` that is **not** NIP-98 authenticated — logins included — must:

1. send `X-Requested-With: beamhop` (or an `Origin` equal to the relay's public origin), and
2. send its body as JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`), or no body at all.

Otherwise you get `403` (`code: "csrf"`) or `415`. This stops other websites from submitting forms to the API with an
admin's cookie. The event import route takes NDJSON instead, and [plugin admin routes](/relay/build/plugin-routes/#admin-routes)
accept any body type, but both still need the header.

<Aside>
Common answers: `401` with no valid session or NIP-98 header, `403` with `code: "not_admin"` for a valid signer
without a role, and `403` with `code: "missing_permission"` when the role lacks the permission.
</Aside>

### Your sessions

| Route | |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /auth/me` | Your pubkey, role, permissions and login factors. |
| `GET /auth/sessions` | Your panel sessions, newest first. |
| `DELETE /auth/sessions/:id` | End one. |
| `POST /auth/sessions/end-others` | End all but the current one (all of them when called with NIP-98). |
| `POST /auth/logout` | End the current session. |

## Roles and permissions

| Permission | owner | admin | moderator | viewer |
| --- | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| `dashboard.view`, `users.view`, `content.view`, `reports.view`, `media.view`, `groups.view`, `settings.view`, `plugins.view` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `users.edit`, `users.ban`, `invites.manage`, `content.delete`, `reports.resolve`, `media.moderate`, `plugins.use` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | |
| `connections.manage`, `users.delete`, `ip.manage`, `content.import`, `content.export`, `groups.manage`, `settings.edit`, `plugins.manage`, `audit.view` | ✓ | ✓ | | |
| `admins.manage` | ✓ | | | |

Moderation is ranked: below owner, nobody can ban, mute, delete or hide the content of a peer or superior. Config
owners (`admin.owners` / `BEAMHOP_OWNERS`) always resolve to `owner`; a banned or deny-listed admin has no access.

## Endpoints

Paths are relative to `/admin/api`.

### System and metrics

| Method & path | Permission | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /system` | `dashboard.view` | Version, runtime, database dialect, advertised NIPs, relay pubkey, public URL, feature flags. |
| `GET /dashboard/snapshot` | `dashboard.view` | Live numbers: connections, events/s, latency, memory, … |
| `GET /metrics/series?name&from&to&step` | `dashboard.view` | A time series. |
| `GET /metrics/kinds`, `/metrics/top-pubkeys`, `/metrics/rejections`, `/metrics/geo` | `dashboard.view` | Breakdowns over `from`/`to` (unix seconds; default the last 24 h). |
| `GET /stream?events=1&kinds=1,7` | `dashboard.view` | Server-Sent Events: `snapshot` every 2 s, `alert`, `report`, and with `events=1` live `event`s. |

### Users

| Method & path | Permission | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /users?search&status&role&tag&allowed&sort&limit&offset` | `users.view` | Paginated users. |
| `POST /users` | `users.edit` | Add a user manually, e.g. to the allow list. |
| `GET /users/:pubkey` | `users.view` | Details and stats (hex or npub). |
| `PATCH /users/:pubkey` | `users.edit` | Notes, tags, rate-limit override, Blossom quota, NIP-05 name, allow/deny flags. |
| `POST /users/:pubkey/ban` · `/unban` · `/mute` · `/unmute` | `users.ban` | `ban` takes `{ reason?, deleteEvents?, deleteMedia?, disconnect? }`. |
| `DELETE /users/:pubkey` | `users.delete` | Removes the record, events and media (not a ban). |
| `PUT /users/:pubkey/role` | `admins.manage` | `{ role }`, or `null` to revoke. |
| `GET /users/:pubkey/events` | `users.view` + `content.view` | A user's events. |
| `POST /users/bulk` | per action | `{ pubkeys, action, reason?, tag? }`. Stops after a 20 s budget and returns `remaining`. |
| `GET /admins` | `users.view` | Users with a role. |

### Content

| Method & path | Permission | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /events/query` | `content.view` | `{ filters, limit? }` with NIP-01 filters. |
| `GET /events/:id` · `DELETE /events/:id` | `content.view` · `content.delete` | |
| `POST /events/delete` | `content.delete` | `{ ids?, filters?, reason? }`. |
| `GET /events/export?filters=<json>` | `content.export` | NDJSON stream. |
| `POST /events/import?bypassPolicies=true` | `content.import` | NDJSON body, one event per line. |
| `GET /events/bans` · `DELETE /events/bans/:id` | `content.view` · `content.delete` | Event ids refused on write. |

### Reports, media, groups

| Method & path | Permission | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /reports?status&type&target&limit&offset` · `GET /reports/:id` | `reports.view` | NIP-56 reports queue. |
| `POST /reports/:id/resolve` · `POST /reports/bulk-resolve` | `reports.resolve` | `action`: `dismiss`, `delete-event`, `ban-user`, `delete-and-ban`, `delete-media`. |
| `GET /media?pubkey&status&type&limit&offset` · `/media/stats` · `/media/:sha256` · `/media/:sha256/raw` | `media.view` | |
| `POST /media/:sha256/status` · `DELETE /media/:sha256?block=true` · `POST /media/bulk` | `media.moderate` | |
| `GET /media/blocklist` · `DELETE /media/blocklist/:sha256` | `media.view` · `media.moderate` | |
| `GET /groups` · `GET /groups/:id` · `DELETE /groups/:id` | `groups.view` · `groups.manage` | NIP-29 groups. |

### Access control, settings, plugins, audit

| Method & path | Permission | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /connections` · `DELETE /connections/:id` · `POST /connections/disconnect` | `connections.manage` | |
| `GET` / `POST /invites` · `DELETE /invites/:code` | `invites.manage` | |
| `GET` / `POST /ip-rules` · `DELETE /ip-rules/:cidr` | `ip.manage` | Allow rules wider than IPv4 /16 or IPv6 /48 need `confirmBroad: true`. |
| `GET /settings` · `PATCH /settings` | `settings.view` · `settings.edit` | Runtime settings; `PATCH` takes a deep partial. |
| `GET /plugins` | `plugins.view` | |
| `POST /plugins/:name/enable` · `/disable` | `plugins.manage` | See [Enabling and disabling](/relay/build/plugin-lifecycle/). |
| `GET /plugins/:name/settings` · `PATCH` | `plugins.view` · `plugins.manage` | `PATCH {values}` merges into the stored settings: top-level fields left out keep their values. See [Settings](/relay/build/plugin-settings/). |
| `ANY /plugins/x/:name/*` | `plugins.use` | [Plugin admin routes](/relay/build/plugin-routes/#admin-routes). |
| `GET /audit?actor&action&target&before&limit` | `audit.view` | Audit log; `before` is an entry id cursor. |

## Example: ban a pubkey with NIP-98

Using [nostr-tools](https://github.com/nbd-wtf/nostr-tools):

```ts
import { finalizeEvent } from "nostr-tools/pure";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";

const base = "https://relay.example.com";
const url = `${base}/admin/api/users/${pubkey}/ban`;
const body = JSON.stringify({ reason: "spam", disconnect: true });

const auth = finalizeEvent({
  kind: 27235,
  created_at: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
  tags: [
    ["u", url],
    ["method", "POST"],
    ["payload", createHash("sha256").update(body).digest("hex")],
  ],
  content: "",
}, secretKey);

const res = await fetch(url, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Nostr ${Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(auth)).toString("base64")}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body,
});
```

For a smaller, standardised set of moderation calls that existing tools already speak, see [NIP-86](/relay/build/nip86/).
